title: Connections, Review & Weak Ties
subtitle: B1 revision of grammar, relationships and listening strategies, with an optional writing challenge.
lessonNotes: This package revises grammar and skills from the 13 November lesson.
Practise modal verbs, time prepositions, past simple and past continuous with while and when.
Use vocabulary about sociability, relationships, places and experiences in clear sentences.
The writing challenge is optional and focuses on the idea of weak ties.

grammar.title: Advice and suggestions
grammar.rule: Use should for advice, could for a possible idea, and can for ability or possibility.

grammar.title: While and when
grammar.rule: Use while with an action in progress and when for a shorter event that happens during it.

grammar.title: Past simple and past continuous
grammar.rule: Use past simple for completed events and was/were + verb-ing for an action in progress.

grammar.title: Time prepositions
grammar.rule: Use at for times, on for days and dates, and in for months, years and longer periods.

reading.title: Reading: A Familiar Face at the Café
reading.text:
Marta had recently moved to a new area and did not know many people. One Saturday, while she was waiting for coffee, she recognised a woman from her yoga class. They started talking about the class and discovered that they both enjoyed walking in the park. The woman suggested a group walk the following weekend.

Marta did not expect to make a close friend immediately, but the conversation made the area feel friendlier. At the walk, she met several more people and learned their names. She realised that small connections can make it easier to belong in a new place. After the walk, she kept in touch with two people and made an effort to join another activity.

listening.title: Listening strategy: connections and main ideas
listening.instructions: Use a familiar B1 listening source about meeting people or social connections. Listen first for the main idea, then note one past event, one suggestion and two relationship words.
listening.script: The interactive homework uses listening-strategy questions so you can practise with a suitable B1 source.

writing: Optional writing challenge: write 100–120 words about a weak tie or small connection that helped someone feel welcome. Use at least two relationship words, one modal verb and one past continuous sentence.
Write a short message inviting a classmate or colleague to an activity. Include one suggestion with could or should and one time expression.
Describe a time when you met someone unexpectedly. Use while or when, past simple and past continuous.
